Text:
Lived in Türkiye 8+ years? Work permits just got easier 🇹🇷

▪️ Since 3 August 2026: 3 criteria no longer apply. No '5 Turkish employees' rule, no employer financial-size check, no minimum salary criterion.
▪️ Who counts?: 8 years on a legal permit. Work permit or short-term, family, student, long-term or humanitarian residence.
▪️ But: It's not automatic. Your employer still applies for a work permit and must meet the other conditions.
